body: Home
Turn enterprise data into AI-powered decisions
Valtech IQ (VTIQ) is a decision intelligence platform that helps teams make faster business decisions using trusted enterprise data.
Across industrial, manufacturing, distribution and agriculture organizations, data lives across ERP, CRM, manufacturing systems, supply chain platforms and analytics.
The challenge isn't collecting more data. It's helping the people closest to the business turn that data into better decisions.
Business teams still rely on manual reporting, disconnected systems and static dashboards to answer operational questions like:
Where should we adjust pricing?
Where should we adjust pricing?
Which inventory locations are at risk?
Which inventory locations are at risk?
Where is demand changing?
Where is demand changing?
Which customers or distributors require attention?

VTIQ connects to your existing systems and transforms trusted enterprise data into AI-powered recommendations that help teams move from question to action in real time.
Enterprise data creates value when it helps teams act with confidence. VTIQ connects trusted business data to AI-powered decision intelligence, helping teams turn questions into decisions.
Enterprise AI Foundations is our approach to helping organizations connect, govern and prepare enterprise data for AI. VTIQ puts those capabilities into practice.

What is Valtech IQ (VTIQ)? Valtech IQ (VTIQ) is an AI-powered decision intelligence platform that transforms trusted enterprise data into faster business decisions. It delivers real-time insights, recommendations and actions without requiring you to replace your existing systems.

Valtech IQ (VTIQ) is an AI-powered decision intelligence platform that transforms trusted enterprise data into faster business decisions. It delivers real-time insights, recommendations and actions without requiring you to replace your existing systems.

How is VTIQ different from traditional BI or reporting tools? Traditional BI tools tell you what happened. VTIQ helps you understand what to do next by turning trusted enterprise data into recommendations and actions.
Traditional BI tools tell you what happened. VTIQ helps you understand what to do next by turning trusted enterprise data into recommendations and actions.

Do we need to replace our existing systems? No. VTIQ connects to your existing ERP, CRM, manufacturing, supply chain and analytics platforms, allowing you to build on your current technology investments without a rip-and-replace approach.
No. VTIQ connects to your existing ERP, CRM, manufacturing, supply chain and analytics platforms, allowing you to build on your current technology investments without a rip-and-replace approach.

Do we need an Enterprise AI Foundation first? No. VTIQ can be deployed against focused business use cases using the data and systems you already have. For organizations looking to strengthen their AI capabilities over time, Enterprise AI Foundations provides a broader approach to connecting data, establishing governance and creating the foundation needed to scale AI across the enterprise. VTIQ is one of the ways organizations operationalize that foundation.

How quickly can we see value? We start with one business function, one high-value decision and one measurable outcome. Most organizations begin demonstrating value within weeks before expanding across the enterprise.
